title: Closing credit to God and others
summary: Monk says he did not do it alone and credits God; the interview is dated Las Vegas, November 2, 1980.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: And I'd just like to add to what all I've said. I don't want ever in the rest of my life to fail to say that...Don't look at me for what I've done. I didn't do this by myself. I had assistance. And a person, number one person, is I believe in God, and that filters down through all this other, the friends and everything else. I didn't do it alone. And I don't want it to ever be looked at as 'he did that.' It didn't...It was for a reason I was here and I just think that I happen to be fulfilling that reason, like the rest of them are. They're out there doing, even the bad guys. We're fulfilling it. There's a reason for us all.
And I believe it's starting from number one, not me. It's that man upstairs and it just filtered down. Right through the bad guys and all.
